desc:
DELICIOUS CEREAL: Naturally and artificially fruit flavored sweetened corn puffs; A delicious ready to eat breakfast cereal for kids and adults

FRUITY SHAPES AND TASTE: Trix cereal features cereal pieces in six colorful fruity shapes with a yummy fruity taste; An ideal pantry staple

MADE WITH WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving provides 14g whole grain per serving (at least 48 grams recommended daily), has a good source of calcium, with 12 vitamins and minerals

KIDS SNACK: Pour a bowl of cold cereal with milk as part of a quick breakfast or an after school snack; Add some to a snack bag to enjoy this cereal on the go

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Trix Fruity Breakfast Cereal, 6 Fruity Shapes, Whole Grain Corn Puffs, 10.7 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

Made with Whole Grain Corn

Provides 14g of whole grain per serving, contributing to a balanced breakfast.

Bold, Fruity Flavor

Naturally and artificially fruit-flavored for a vibrant, sweet, and tangy taste kids love.

Fun Shapes & Bright Colors

Colorful, fruity-shaped puffs designed to be visually fun and engaging, especially for children.

Fortified with 12 Essential Vitamins & Minerals

Includes nutrients like vitamin D, calcium, iron, and B vitamins to support daily nutrition.

Gluten-Free

Suitable for individuals avoiding gluten in their diets.

Low in Fat & Cholesterol-Free

Offers a light breakfast or snack option without added fats or cholesterol.

Benefits

Kid-Friendly Appeal

The sweet taste, colorful look, and fun shapes make breakfast exciting for children, helping to encourage morning routines.

Quick and Easy Meal

A fast, no-prep breakfast or snack for busy mornings or on-the-go needs.

Nutritionally Supported Choice

Fortified with important nutrients to help support growing bodies and active lifestyles.

Diet-Inclusive

Gluten-free and free from most common allergens, making it more accessible for a variety of diets.

Versatile Use

Enjoy it with milk, as a dry snack, or added to cereal bars and homemade snack mixes.
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Rice Flour, Corn Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Trisodium Phosphate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Red 40, Yellow 6, Blue 1 and Other Color Added, Citric Acid, Malic Acid, Rosemary Extract. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
